params.name: underlying
params.description: The underlying asset symbol for the requested market data. For example, `BTC` or `ETH`.

params.name: quoted_currency
params.description: Quoted currency symbol. For example, `USD` or `EUR`. This is the currency in which the price is quoted.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of symbols and their market data.

params.name: underlying
params.description: Filter for underlying asset in the trading pair. E.g., `BTC` for `BTC/USD` related OHLCV data.

params.name: quoted_currency
params.description: Filter for quoted asset in the trading pair. E.g., `USD` for `BTC/USD` related OHLCV data.

params.name: limit
params.description: Filter for maximum number of data points to be returned in a single request. Default is `50` if not specified.

params.name: data_end_date
params.description: Filter for objects before given timestamp. E.g., `1780876800` for June 8, 2026.

params.name: all_data
params.description: Filter for all data available. Defaults to `false`. If set to `true`, `time_frame` is ignored and all available data is returned with `daily` granularity.

params.name: time_frame
params.description: Filter for `time_frame` of the OHLCV data. Required if `all_data` is not set to `true`. E.g., `daily` for daily OHLCV data.

items.docs: Retrieves an list of historical data of open, high, low, close, underlying_volume and quoted_volume.

params.name: news_source
params.description: Sources (feeds) of news articles, options can be fetched from the response of `GET /news/feeds` endpoint.

params.name: categories
params.description: Categories of news articles, options can be fetched from the response of `GET /news/categories` endpoint.

params.name: exclude_categories
params.description: Categories of news articles to be excluded from result, options can be fetched from the response of `GET /news/categories` endpoint.

params.name: lookback
params.description: A lookback time defined as a UNIX timestamp, used to fetch articles from the given time.

params.name: language
params.description: Language of articles to be fetched. Format: `EN` (English) or `PT` (Portuguese)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sorting order of news articles. Can be either `popular` or `latest`

items.docs: Retrieves a list of market news articles filtered using given parameters.
Retrieves a list of available market data feeds, which can be used to query articles.
Retrieves a list of available market data categories, which can be used to query articles.

params.name: path
params.description: Arbitrary sub-path of the image resource (e.g. `resources/news/64/12888774.jpeg`).

items.docs:
Deprecated: this endpoint is no longer maintained and may be removed in a future release. Returns the binary content of an image at the given path (usually received from another Market Data endpoint). The image path is appended to the endpoint URL.

Example:

- For path: `/resources/news/64/12888774.jpeg`
- Request: `GET /market_data/image/resources/news/64/12888774.jpeg`
